title: Public Alert No. 09/2026 – Public Reminder of NAFDAC’s Regulatory Directive on the Discontinued Registration of Multi-Dose Artemether /Lumefantrine Dry Powder for Oral Suspension

products.brand: All brands of Multi-Dose Artemether/Lumefantrine dry powder for oral suspension
products.manufacturer: All manufacturers and importers of Multi-Dose Anti-Malarial (Artemether/Lumefantrine) dry powder Oral Suspension

summary: NAFDAC reminds the public that registration of all multi-dose Artemether/Lumefantrine dry powder for oral suspension has been discontinued because reconstituted suspensions are unstable and lose efficacy. Importation, distribution, sale and use must stop; products are still in ci
